issue.title: Use body typography in Weather and natural heights for Calendar pair
issue.description:
Refine the Weather typography and make the Calendar + Weather local pair use natural content-driven heights instead of stretching to equal height.

1. Weather typography

Owner direction:

* Keep the current visual sizes/weights of the main temperature and location name.
* Change the font-family role so both use the Sans/Body typography family rather than Heading.
* The goal is for the entire Weather composition to use Sans/Body typography while preserving visual hierarchy through size and weight.

Specifically:

* current temperature (for example 21°) -> Body/Sans family;
* location name (for example Lisbon) -> Body/Sans family;
* keep their current size/weight unless a tiny adjustment is required to preserve the accepted visual balance;
* do not convert supporting weather copy to Mono or introduce a new type role.

Preserve:

* current Weather layout;
* current iconography;
* high/low values;
* condition text;
* multi-day forecast;
* semantic token styling;
* light/dark behavior.

2. Calendar + Weather local row height behavior

Owner direction:

* The Calendar and Weather pair should no longer stretch vertically to match each other's height.
* Each card should follow its own natural/content-driven height.
* Calendar should end when its content ends.
* Weather should end when its content ends.

Important scope boundary:

* This is a local exception only for the Calendar + Weather pair.
* Do not change the equal-height/stretch behavior of other intentional paired cards on the right column.
* Do not globally change gallery row alignment or card-height rules.

Implementation preference:

* Use local grid/flex alignment such as items-start or equivalent where appropriate.
* Remove h-full/min-h-full/stretch behavior only from this specific pair if that is what currently forces equal height.
* Do not use fixed pixel heights.
* Preserve the existing narrower-Calendar / wider-Weather relationship.
* Preserve responsive stacking at narrower container widths.

Acceptance:

* Weather current temperature uses Body/Sans typography while keeping its current visual prominence.
* Weather location name uses Body/Sans typography while keeping its current visual prominence.
* Weather composition no longer relies on Heading font-family for those two elements.
* Calendar and Weather render at independent natural heights when side-by-side.
* The shorter card is not stretched to match the taller card.
* Other paired rows that intentionally use equal-height behavior remain unchanged.
* Responsive stacking remains correct.
* No overflow, clipping, focus-order, accessibility, theme, or layout regression.
